method: Read-only source JSX/CSS audit. Original desktop runtime not rendered. Independent demo computed styles are in browser-final.json.

destinations.status: **Differs.** Core chart/widget geometry is matched. Approval timestamps remain absolute preference-formatted dates instead of source relative text; shared status badges and semantic accessible ink colours differ. Loading uses a shared loading state instead of four KPI/widget skeletons.
